topics.hook_summary: Some of my own members are hating on it, they're fighting this project. I like it. Spawn is the first and only PONS-native token that pays PONS every two hours and burns itself every 30 minutes; by the KNOTS-to-STONK math it should be way bigger, not 75x smaller. If you got in now you'll be like: damn, I got in at 50K. A 5 million market cap is 100x.

I'm even open to Golden Kitty rugging tomorrow, if you tell me why, but it's just too dispersed for that to happen; many groups, many influencers pushing it, one of the only good charts in memes. It's a 4 million market cap right now; if this is a billion dollar token there's a lot of gains over this bull run. And it's going to pump really hard.

First two weeks of September were crazy: Perps Pad 114x, Ethics 17x, Perps 15x, STONK 13x, OTC 9x. One launchpad call did 114x in eight days. Peanut, I got in on the pump and still did a 52x. This month is probably going to be more than the entire year of 2025, and there was a 550x on MYX. That's what you get for joining my group.

The four-year cycle zombies pushed us below the 50-week SMA last November, and now they're pushing us back above it. They took out Bitcoin's May swing high and Benjamin Cowen says he's absolutely perplexed. They checked out for the bear market, some already realized the bottom is in, and they're front-running the quote unquote October bottom. Hordes and hordes of zombies are buying back in.
